newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Multipolar EGM approves Matahari buy.
newsitem.headline: Multipolar EGM approves Matahari buy.

text.p: Shareholders of Indonesia's retailer PT Multipolar Corporation approved on Thursday the Lippo Group unit's plan to acquire a 50.1-percent stake in large retailer PT Matahari Putra Prima.

"The extraordinary shareholders' meeting of PT Multipolar Corporation, a unit of the Lippo (Group), has approved the purchase (of a 45-percent stake) of PT Matahari Putra Prima through options," Multipolar said in a statement.
The statement said the sharehholders had also approved the firm's plan to buy a 5.1-percent stake in Matahari through a tender offer.
Multipolar will finance the acquisition through its own internal funds and proceeds from an expected rights issue.
It said the acquisition would increase its profit by a minimum of 400 percent, but did not give a specific year.
It said it expected its sales in 1997 to reach two trillion rupiah and expected to increase this to 10 trillion rupiah within the next 10 years.
No other figures were immediately available. $=2,373 rupiah
